title: Full Day Private Customized Sightseeing Tour in Oahu Hawaii
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Skip the bigger bus tour and take a PRIVATE tour, you won’t regret it! That's right, just YOU and your group tour Oahu's natural landscape and rich heritage on this PRIVATE full-day, small-group tour. There's so much to see outside of Waikiki. Kiko and her guides have lived in Hawaii for decades or longer, they give custom suggested itineraries and money-saving tips; we go where the locals go brah! Enjoy the ride, as we traverse and tour Oahu, making as many stops as you desire, for food, fun, and memories. North Shore some beaches tours are prohibited from stopping but we do our best to see turtles, Haleiwa town, Pipeline and Sunset beach too. Of course, Dole whip and there's an option to swim in a 45 foot waterfall! Custom and private tours the last up to 8 hours. XLE van seats 6 passengers. Sunroof, music, tunes, and more. 
Go Kikos!
